DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の案内についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the park information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 橋が通れないので、公園全体が閉まったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 橋閉鎖を公園全体閉鎖と思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since the bridge is closed, I thought the whole park had closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you mistook the bridge closure for closure of the whole park. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示の対象を確認しましょう。ほかの道は当日の案内で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check what this sign covers. You can check other paths using today's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 橋だけの表示でした。公園全部が使えないと同行者へ伝える前に、経路を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示範囲を確認し同行者への断定を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sign was only for the bridge. Before telling my companion the entire park is unavailable, I would like to ask about a route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the scope of the sign and avoid a definite claim to your companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行きたい場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where would you like to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花壇です。通れない橋を迂回する道があれば、入口から戻れる範囲で行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花壇と戻れる範囲の迂回を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The flower beds. If there is a detour around the closed bridge, I would like to go only as far as I can return to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the flower beds and a detour within a distance you can return from. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の通行案内を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us look at the on-site passage information together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内にない細い道へ入って近道しません。遠回りが大きければ今日は近くで休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 非指定近道を避け長距離なら近場を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not take an unmarked narrow path as a shortcut. If the detour is long, I will rest nearby today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid undesignated shortcuts and choose somewhere nearby if the distance is long. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの経路が案内されています。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 距離を確認して今日は近くのベンチにします。同行者には橋の範囲の制限だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 近場休憩を選び制限範囲を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Having checked the distance, I will choose a nearby bench today. I will tell my companion the restriction covers the bridge area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a nearby rest spot and share the restricted area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、指定の休憩場所をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please use the designated rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの行先へ乗り換えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which destination are you transferring toward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この駅です。向かい側も同じ方向と思い、先に来る方へ乗ろうとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同ホーム両側を同方向と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This station. I thought the opposite side went the same direction too and was about to board whichever came first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought both sides of the platform went the same direction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じホームでも行先は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even on the same platform, we check destinations separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ホーム番号だけ見ていました。列車の行先と停車駅を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号と行先停車駅を分け確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was looking only at the platform number. I want to check the train's destination and stops.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the number separately from the destination and stopping stations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示と当日の案内で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the display and today's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急いで向かいの扉へ行かず、目的駅に止まる便か聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 向かい扉へ急がず目的駅停車を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not rush to the doors opposite; I will ask whether the service stops at my destination station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not rush to the opposite doors; ask whether it stops at your destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内をご覧ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者が向かい側で待っています。先に乗らないよう伝え、行先を確認して合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の先乗りを止め行先確認後合流する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion is waiting on the opposite side. I will ask them not to board first, check the destination, and meet up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Stop your companion boarding ahead and meet after checking the destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 流れを妨げない所で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check somewhere that does not obstruct the flow of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。案内された場所で合流し、同じホームという理由だけで便を選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通行を避け便の表示で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will meet them at the place indicated and will not choose a service just because it uses the same platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Stay out of the flow and choose based on the service display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では行先表示を確認してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the destination display and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族三人載せたいので三通と書きました。一人ずつの紙の意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数を通数に記入した疑問を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want three family members listed, so I wrote three copies. Does that mean a separate sheet for each person?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about having entered the number of people as the number of copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通数と記載する範囲は別です。提出先の希望を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The number of copies and the information included are separate. Let us check what the submission destination requests.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 提出先は一枚に世帯情報とあります。人数を紙の数にしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先の一枚指定と誤解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The destination says household information on one sheet. I had turned the number of people into the number of sheets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination's one-sheet requirement and your misunderstanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な記載内容も担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will also check what information must be included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の情報が全部必要とは自分で決めず、提出案内を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要記載を推測せず案内を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show the submission instructions rather than decide myself that all family information is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the instructions without guessing which details are required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内で対象と通数を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will use these instructions to check who is covered and how many copies are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三通の申請のまま進めず、必要な一通へ直せるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三通申請を止め訂正方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to stop the request for three copies and ask whether I can correct it to the one necessary copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Stop the three-copy application and ask how to correct it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 訂正方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the correction method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。記載する範囲と通数を別に確認してから申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 範囲と通数確認後に申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check the scope of information separately from the number of copies before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply after checking the scope and number of copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us confirm that with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の使用はないという記入ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have indicated that you do not use medication, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は飲んでいないので、なしにしました。普段使う薬はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日未服用だが通常薬があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I did not take any today, so I wrote none. But I do have medication I normally use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have usual medication although you have not taken it today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日の服用と、使用している薬の情報を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check today's doses separately from information about the medication you use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日だけの質問と思っていました。普段の薬を担当に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 問診の誤解を訂正し使用歴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the question was only about today. I would like to tell the staff member about my usual medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding of the questionnaire and report your medication history. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you brought information about the medication?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前の分かる説明書があります。飲まなかった理由も診療で話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明書と未服用理由を担当へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an information sheet showing the names. I will also explain during the consultation why I did not take it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the information sheet and reason for not taking it to the staff member. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 判断は医療職が確認します。今ここで服用を変える案内はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: A healthcare professional will assess it. We will not instruct you to change your medication here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自己判断で埋め合わせて飲まず、今日は未服用の状態として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己補充服用をせず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not take extra doses on my own to make up for it. I will discuss the situation as not having taken it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not take replacement doses yourself; consult the staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ使用歴と今日の状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will tell the staff member your medication history and today's situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。薬なしの記入を訂正し、説明書と未服用の状況を別に示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬なし記入を直し使用薬と当日状態を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will correct the no-medication entry and show the information sheet separately from the circumstances of not taking it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the no-medication entry and separate usual medicine from today's situation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass it on that way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの連絡を受けましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 未払いのメールです。検索の一番上の広告へ電話すれば本当か確認できると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不審メールを検索広告へ照会しようとしたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An email about an unpaid bill. I thought calling the ad at the top of the search results would tell me whether it is genuine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you were going to ask a search ad about a suspicious email. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検索広告の番号だけで正規の窓口とは確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: A search advertisement's number alone does not confirm it is the official contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ電話していません。メールの番号とも別ですが、広告なら安心と考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未電話と広告への信頼の誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not called yet. It is different from the email number, but I thought an ad would be safe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not called and your mistaken trust in the advertisement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 以前から利用しているサービスの案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have information from the service you have already been using?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の契約書があります。その連絡先と、メールの内容を分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約書の既存連絡先で照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the original contract. I would like to check its contact information separately from the email's contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to verify using the existing contact details in the contract. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メールの情報は残して、確認方法を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the email information; we can discuss how to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広告の相手へ契約番号を先に伝えることはしません。問い合わせ先を元の資料で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未知番号へ契約情報を渡さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not first give my contract number to the person in the ad. I will check the contact using the original documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not disclose contract information to an unknown number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 被害があればその内容も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have suffered any harm, please tell us about it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は送金も情報提供もしていません。その状態を伝え、正規窓口へ確認する手順を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未送金未提供を伝え確認手順を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not sent money or provided information yet. I will state that and discuss the steps for checking with the official contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State that no money or information has been sent and discuss verification steps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、メールと元の資料を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will hear about the email and original documents separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この発送方法では送料が不足しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: There is not enough postage for this shipping method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中の品は買う時に払いました。まだ商品の代金が足りないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送料不足を商品代金不足か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I paid for the item inside when I bought it. Is there still some of the product price unpaid?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether insufficient postage means insufficient payment for the product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容品の購入代金と、郵便の送料は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The contents' purchase price and mailing postage are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商品の支払いが発送代も含むと思っていました。この荷物の送料を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入代と送料を分け荷物料金を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought paying for the product included shipping too. I want to check this parcel's postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the purchase price from postage and ask the parcel charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重さと方法で確認します。差出し先はこの住所ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check based on weight and method. This is the destination address, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。レシートの購入額を送料欄へ書くのでなく、発送条件で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入額でなく発送条件を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check based on shipping conditions rather than writing the receipt's purchase amount in the postage field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present shipping conditions rather than the purchase amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが今回の料金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the charge for this shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 額が分かりました。手元の切手がこの方法で使えるかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 算定額と手持切手の利用方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand the amount. Please also check whether the stamps I have can be used with this method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the calculated amount and how your existing stamps can be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使用方法を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will check how they can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。内容品代金と送料を分け、切手の扱いを確認して不足分を支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用方法後に送料不足分を払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will distinguish the product price from postage, confirm how to use the stamps, and pay the shortage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay the missing postage after checking how the stamps can be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その方法で受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will proceed with acceptance that way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この番号は振込先の情報ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this number the recipient account information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書の大きい番号を書きました。自分の顧客番号かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 顧客番号かもしれない番号を書いたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the large number on the invoice. It may be my customer number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote a number that might be a customer number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座番号と顧客識別は別です。請求書の見出しを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: An account number and customer identification are different. Let us check the invoice headings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 顧客番号と書いてありました。まだ振り込んでいません。口座欄を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見出しを読んで未送金と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It said customer number. I have not transferred money yet. I want to check the account field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the heading and confirm that no money has been sent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送金先の情報が分からなければ、請求元へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you do not know the recipient account details, please check with the billing company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 口座の欄が見つからないので、元から使っている連絡先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明口座を既存請求元連絡先に照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot find an account field, so I will ask using the contact I have already been using.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the existing billing-company contact about the unknown account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できるまで番号を推測しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not guess the number until it is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。顧客番号は支払参照に必要かも別に聞き、口座へ流用しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 顧客参照の用途も別に聞き流用しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will also ask separately whether the customer number is needed as a payment reference; I will not use it as an account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask separately about customer-reference use and do not substitute it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正しい情報で手続きを案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can guide you through the procedure with the correct information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では今日は入力を進めず、受取口座と顧客番号の用途を確認して戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認まで入力を止め二番号の用途を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will not proceed with entry today. I will check the recipient account and the customer number's purpose before returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Stop entry until checking and clarify the two numbers' purposes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた資料をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the confirmed documents as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払い方法はいかがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族のカードを見せたので、そこから払われたと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族ポイントカードで払われたと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I showed my family's card, so I thought payment had been taken from it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the family points card paid for the purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのカードはポイントの案内です。支払いとは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That card concerns points. We will check payment separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ支払いはしていませんね。家族のカードを使える条件も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未支払を認めカード条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I have not paid yet. I would also like to ask about the conditions for using my family's card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge nonpayment and ask about the card conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カード利用の条件を担当へ確認します。まず会計の支払方法を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask the staff member about card-use conditions. First, let us decide how you will pay at checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 現金で払います。カードを見せた回数で商品を払ったことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金を選び提示と支払を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will pay cash. I will not treat showing the card, however many times, as paying for the goods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose cash and distinguish presentation from payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ポイントについては条件確認後に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain points after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の分を付けられると決めず、今回は自分の支払いを先に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人ポイント付与を前提にせず会計を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume points can be credited to my family's card; I will confirm my own payment first this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Proceed with checkout without assuming points for someone else. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現金のお会計はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額を確認して払います。ポイントの扱いは支払い記録と別に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現金額を確認しポイント扱いを別照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the amount and pay. I will ask about points separately from the payment record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the cash amount and ask separately about points. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お支払いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us confirm your payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その区画の表示についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the sign for that area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手入れ中なので、手伝う人を募集していると思いました。草を取ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 養生表示を作業募集と思ったと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says maintenance in progress, so I thought they were looking for helpers. May I pull weeds?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your misunderstanding that a care-area sign was recruiting workers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その札は立入りの条件を示しています。参加募集ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That sign indicates entry conditions. It is not a recruitment notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ入っていません。養生という言葉を作業参加の案内と混同しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未立入と語の混同を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not entered yet. I confused the word for protecting the area with information about joining the work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not entered and confused the wording. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手伝いを希望する場合は、別の案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you want to help, please check separate information about that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勝手に作業しません。募集があるか公園の窓口で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無断作業をやめ正式募集を窓口に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not work without permission. I would like to ask the park counter whether volunteers are being recruited.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not work without authorization; ask the counter about official recruitment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の通行経路はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The current walking route is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 区画を横切って窓口へ行かず、指定経路を使います。道具も持ち込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定経路を使い区画横断と道具持込をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the designated route rather than cross the area to get to the counter. I will not bring tools in either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the designated route without crossing the area or bringing tools in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 窓口で活動の条件を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check activity conditions at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は立入り表示を守り、参加できる活動があるか説明を聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 立入条件を守り募集説明後に参加を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I will obey the entry sign and decide whether to participate after hearing whether any activities are available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Obey entry conditions and decide about participation after the recruitment explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この経路へお進みください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの列車の到着時刻を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which train's arrival time would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この列車です。十分遅れとあるので、十分で目的地に着くと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅れの十分を乗車時間と取り違えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This train. It says ten minutes late, so I thought I would reach my destination in ten minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the ten-minute delay for travel time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十分は予定からの遅れです。目的地までの乗車時間とは別ですが、何時までに着きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ten minutes is the delay from the schedule. It is separate from travel time to your destination. By what time do you need to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十一時までです。まだ乗車時間を計算に入れていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着期限と未計算の乗車時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: By eleven. I had not included the train travel time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your arrival deadline and the travel time you had not calculated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 目的地はどちらですか。列車を降りてからの移動もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where is your destination? Do you also need to travel after leaving the train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 終点から徒歩十五分の会場です。その時間も含めて見積もってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 降車後の徒歩十五分を計算に含めるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: A venue fifteen minutes' walk from the last stop. Please include that time in the estimate too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to include the fifteen-minute walk after leaving the train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の案内で計算しますが、遅れは変わる可能性があります。間に合わない場合はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will calculate using the current information, but the delay may change. What will you do if you cannot arrive in time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会場に連絡します。まず、今の見込みでは何時ごろ着くか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅れが変わることを踏まえて現在の到着見込みを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact the venue. First, please tell me about what time I can arrive based on the current estimate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the current estimated arrival, recognizing the delay may change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会場到着は十一時十分ごろの見込みです。別の経路も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your arrival at the venue is estimated at about eleven ten. Would you like to check another route too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗り換えを増やす前に会場へ連絡します。この列車の案内も引き続き確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 経路変更より先に会場へ連絡する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact the venue before adding more transfers. I will also keep checking this train's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your plan to contact the venue before changing routes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。到着見込みを伝えるときは、現在の案内に基づく時刻だと添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. When you give the estimated arrival, please add that it is based on current information.
